title: Correction — structural placeholder
description: Subjects of an exact correction record preserving predecessor truth and remaining uncertainty.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

error.description: Error being corrected, rather than an unexplained replacement.

affected_target.description: Exact State, representation, attribution, or other affected target.

prior_state_or_representation.description: Recoverable prior object; correcting a representation is not automatically a change of State.

resulting_delta.description: Exact difference produced by the correction.

remaining_uncertainty.description: Unresolved or unsupported matters left visible after correction.

preserved_history.description: Enough predecessor history to explain what changed and why, without making earlier occurrences unoccurred.

repair_ceiling.description: Limits on claims of remedy, recognition, reconciliation, restored autonomy, or restored continuity.
